column4: toolchain-gated: the cleat#4079 worker test builds real Python components with componentize-py and needs a database, which THIS job does not install. Python is tier 1, and its toolchain is provisioned by the tier-1 Gate's rest shard and by e2e-cross-language.yml, not by test-go/commands. The gate is legitimate rather than convenient: buildPythonExample calls t.Fatalf, not t.Skip, when CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS names python, so a job that PROMISES the toolchain cannot silently skip this. The parent PASSES and each SUBTEST skips, because every subtest calls buildPythonExample first (through `run`) and that is where the gate is. So the count is of subtests: 12 today (10 t.Run sites, one of them the loop over the three settlement shapes). Measured in CI on cd87539f as 11 before the compaction subtest was added; this line once counted the parent, which stopped skipping when the test was split into subtests. Add a subtest to this test and this number goes up by one.
